newsitem.title: CANADA: Exall says Glimmer could be on line by June.
newsitem.headline: Exall says Glimmer could be on line by June.

text.p: Exall Resources Ltd said on Wednesday that it could put its Glimmer Mine in Northeastern Ontario into commercial production as early as July.
The mining company said if begun in July production could be at an annual rate of 65,000 ounces of gold with cash operating costs of US$220 per ounce.
It said the mineable reserve contains 180,000 ounces of gold at a grade of 0.36 ounces per ton and the drill-indicated reserve 440,000 ounces. The deposit remains open at depth and along strike.
Exall said results at its DDH 97-198 drill hole collared between the east and west orebodies of the Glimmer mine intersected 7.29 ounces (226.67 grams) of gold per ton across one meter.
The mining and exploration company said that diluted to a mineable width, the intersection cut four ounces per ton across 1.8 meters.
Exall said that these results were the first indication that the unexplored central portion of the property may be gold mineralized and actually connect the two orebodies.
The company said a second hole, DDH 97-197 also collared the central zone about 12.5 meters west of DDH 97-198 intersected 0.31 ounces of gold per ton across 1.80 meters.
